story.title: From idea to reality
paragraphs: Aibooking.dk was founded with a clear vision: to make professional customer service accessible to every business, regardless of size.

The people behind Aibooking.dk have more than 20 years of experience in telemarketing tasks, both inbound and outbound. We know exactly how many resources Danish businesses spend on customer contact. This deep knowledge has driven us to develop an AI solution that acts as Your Virtual Receptionist, effectively automating many of the repetitive tasks that would otherwise require significant staff resources.

Through our years of experience, we discovered that many small and medium-sized businesses were losing valuable customers because they didn't have the resources to answer every inquiry around the clock. Our solution combines advanced AI technology with Danish language and culture.
Today we serve hundreds of businesses across Denmark, helping them improve their customer service, increase their booking rate, and free up time for what they do best.
